diff --git a/test_securityscan_integrity_repair.py b/test_securityscan_integrity_repair.py

+++ b/test_securityscan_integrity_repair.py
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+import os
+import sys
+import unittest
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from datetime import timedelta
+
+
+class RunConfiguredDjangoTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def runTest(self):
+        from pkg_resources import load_entry_point
+        previous_args = sys.argv[:]
+        previous_skip = os.environ.get('SKIP_MIGRATIONS')
+        os.environ['SKIP_MIGRATIONS'] = '1'
+        sys.argv = ['test_ralph', 'test', 'test_securityscan_integrity_repair', '-v', '2']
+        try:
+            try:
+                load_entry_point('ralph', 'console_scripts', 'test_ralph')()
+            except SystemExit as exc:
+                self.assertIn(exc.code, (None, 0))
+        finally:
+            sys.argv = previous_args
+            if previous_skip is None:
+                os.environ.pop('SKIP_MIGRATIONS', None)
+            else:
+                os.environ['SKIP_MIGRATIONS'] = previous_skip
+
+
+def database_suite(loader):
+    from django.apps import apps
+    from django.db import IntegrityError, connection, transaction
+    from django.db.migrations.loader import MigrationLoader
+    from django.test import TransactionTestCase, override_settings
+    from django.utils import timezone
+    from ralph.security.tests import test_api as fixtures
+
+    class ScanIntegrityTests(TransactionTestCase):
+        @contextmanager
+        def upgraded_history(self):
+            baseline = ('security', '0003_auto_20170110_1352')
+            current_scan = apps.get_model('security', 'SecurityScan')
+            hosts = [fixtures.IPAddressFactory(address='192.0.2.{}'.format(80 + i)).base_object
+                     for i in range(4)]
+            prototype = fixtures.SecurityScanFactory(base_object=hosts[0])
+            vulnerabilities = [fixtures.VulnerabilityFactory(), fixtures.VulnerabilityFactory()]
+            with override_settings(MIGRATION_MODULES={}):
+                migration_loader = MigrationLoader(None)
+                state = migration_loader.project_state([baseline])
+                historical_scan = state.apps.get_model('security', 'SecurityScan')
+                template = {field.attname: getattr(prototype, field.attname)
+                            for field in historical_scan._meta.concrete_fields
+                            if not field.primary_key}
+                completed = set(migration_loader.graph.forwards_plan(baseline))
+                with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
+                    editor.delete_model(current_scan)
+                    editor.create_model(historical_scan)
+                try:
+                    start = timezone.now().replace(microsecond=0) - timedelta(days=30)
+
+                    def seed(host, days, label, vulnerability):
+                        values = dict(template)
+                        values.update(base_object_id=host.pk,
+                                      last_scan_date=start + timedelta(days=days),
+                                      next_scan_date=start + timedelta(days=days + 3),
+                                      details_url='http://example.com/scans/' + label,
+                                      rescan_url='http://example.com/rescan/' + label)
+                        row = historical_scan.objects.create(**values)
+                        row.vulnerabilities.add(vulnerability.pk)
+                        return row
+
+                    seed(hosts[0], 3, 'a-middle', vulnerabilities[0])
+                    a_latest = seed(hosts[0], 9, 'a-latest', vulnerabilities[1])
+                    seed(hosts[0], 1, 'a-oldest', vulnerabilities[0])
+                    b_latest = seed(hosts[1], 6, 'b-latest', vulnerabilities[0])
+                    seed(hosts[1], 2, 'b-oldest', vulnerabilities[1])
+                    singleton = seed(hosts[2], 4, 'singleton', vulnerabilities[1])
+                    fields = ('last_scan_date', 'next_scan_date', 'scan_status',
+                              'details_url', 'rescan_url')
+                    expected = {}
+                    for host, row in zip(hosts, [a_latest, b_latest, singleton]):
+                        expected[host.pk] = (
+                            {name: getattr(row, name) for name in fields},
+                            set(row.vulnerabilities.values_list('pk', flat=True)))
+                    for leaf in migration_loader.graph.leaf_nodes('security'):
+                        for node in migration_loader.graph.forwards_plan(leaf):
+                            if node[0] != 'security' or node in completed:
+                                continue
+                            with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
+                                state = migration_loader.disk_migrations[node].apply(state, editor)
+                            completed.add(node)
+                    yield state.apps.get_model('security', 'SecurityScan'), hosts, expected
+                finally:
+                    final_scan = state.apps.get_model('security', 'SecurityScan')
+                    with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
+                        editor.delete_model(final_scan)
+                        editor.create_model(current_scan)
+
+        def test_cleanup_preserves_latest_complete_state_for_each_host(self):
+            with self.upgraded_history() as fixture:
+                scan_model, hosts, expected = fixture
+                for host in hosts[:3]:
+                    rows = scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=host.pk)
+                    self.assertEqual(rows.count(), 1)
+                    row = rows.get()
+                    values, vulnerability_ids = expected[host.pk]
+                    for name, value in values.items():
+                        self.assertEqual(getattr(row, name), value)
+                    self.assertEqual(set(row.vulnerabilities.values_list('pk', flat=True)),
+                                     vulnerability_ids)
+                self.assertEqual(scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=hosts[3].pk).count(), 0)
+
+        def test_upgraded_database_prevents_duplicate_writes(self):
+            with self.upgraded_history() as fixture:
+                scan_model, hosts, _ = fixture
+                target = hosts[0].pk
+                self.assertEqual(scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=target).count(), 1)
+                existing = scan_model.objects.get(base_object_id=target)
+                duplicate = {field.attname: getattr(existing, field.attname)
+                             for field in scan_model._meta.concrete_fields if not field.primary_key}
+                try:
+                    with transaction.atomic():
+                        scan_model.objects.create(**duplicate)
+                except IntegrityError:
+                    pass
+                self.assertEqual(scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=target).count(), 1)
+                other = scan_model.objects.get(base_object_id=hosts[1].pk)
+                try:
+                    with transaction.atomic():
+                        scan_model.objects.filter(pk=other.pk).update(base_object_id=target)
+                except IntegrityError:
+                    pass
+                self.assertEqual(scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=target).count(), 1)
+                self.assertEqual(scan_model.objects.filter(base_object_id=hosts[2].pk).count(), 1)
+
+    return loader.loadTestsFromTestCase(ScanIntegrityTests)
+
+
+def load_tests(loader, tests, pattern):
+    from django.conf import settings
+    if settings.configured:
+        return database_suite(loader)
+    return unittest.TestSuite([RunConfiguredDjangoTests()])
